title: Local Communities
subtitle: 「本地社群／地區社區」，要先分清是在談附近居民整體、正式社區團體、居民協會，還是項目諮詢中的本地持份者。
description: 「本地社群／地區社區」，要先分清是在談附近居民整體、正式社區團體、居民協會，還是項目諮詢中的本地持份者。

words.example: The project will create jobs for nearby communities.
words.exampleZh: 該項目將為附近社群創造就業機會。

exercises.original: The new hospital will serve local communities close to the site.
exercises.zh: 新醫院將服務場址附近的社群。
exercises.upgrade: The new hospital will serve nearby communities.

options.explanation: close to the site directly signals nearby communities。
local area is a place, not people。
population only is statistical and less social。
community groups only excludes unorganised residents。
stakeholders are defined by interest in a decision。
neighbourhood is usually a place or one local district.

exercises.original: The project is expected to create jobs for local communities around the port.
exercises.zh: 項目預計為港口附近社群創造職位。
exercises.upgrade: The project is expected to create jobs for nearby communities around the port.

options.explanation: around the port + employment benefit is geographic proximity, so nearby communities fits。
local area/neighbourhood streets are place terms。
community groups/stakeholders only are narrower organised subsets。
population statistics is too demographic.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Emergency teams contacted local communities near the river.

exercises.upgrade: Emergency teams contacted nearby communities near the river.

options.explanation: communities near a specific river are nearby communities。
local area/communal areas are places。
population is statistical。
residents' associations only is too narrow。
stakeholders is project-interest language.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

options.explanation: resident-led organised groups in one area are neighbourhood groups。
local area/neighbourhood streets are places。
population is demographic。
nearby communities refers broader collectives。
stakeholders is interest-based and less specific to resident organisation.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

options.explanation: sending representatives implies organised groups, fitting neighbourhood groups。

nearby communities are broader collectives。

falseSynonyms.zh: 本地區域不等於 local communities local area 是地理範圍；communities 是人和社會群體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Area is a place; community is people.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社區／街區不等於所有 communities neighbourhood 可指地理街區，也可指社區，但語義更偏地點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Neighbourhood is often place-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 居民不等於所有 local communities residents 只指住戶，不包括商戶、學校或組織。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Residents are one part of a community.

falseSynonyms.zh: 持份者不等於所有 community members stakeholders 因某決策或項目而受影響／有利益關係。
人口不等於 community population 是統計集合；community 強調關係、身份和互動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Population is demographic, community is social.

falseSynonyms.zh: community groups 只是組織化的一部分 整個 local community 不一定全部屬於任何 group。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Groups are organised subsets.

falseSynonyms.zh: nearby 只強調距離接近 local communities 可以是行政／社會上本地但不一定緊鄰。
詞形陷阱 community 是名詞；communal 是形容詞，常表示共用／集體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Community is a noun; communal is an adjective.
